jungjipdo's entry for blake3 round 3 (124.91252). Credited for two ideas, re-implemented here from the text of its proof Sections 3.3 and 3.4 (no file of that entry was used or run): the pivot full adder (the input whose polarity differs is the pivot; u = x ^ p, sum = u ^ y, carry = ((u & (y ^ p)) ^ p); five gates per bit) and the mask walk g = f XOR q (the digest planes are fed back as stored, so no complement and no polarity search are needed, and equality under g is equivalent to equality under f).
evidence: proof.md first paragraph and Sections 1, 3.2, 3.3 and 8.
